topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and outlines the learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Tumor viruses and experimental assays for cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular oncogenes and the development of laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Classes and mechanisms of oncogenic and tumor suppressor mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the functional definitions, regulatory pathways, and mutational mechanisms that distinguish oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular origins and cellular effects of sequence instability and chromosomal instability arising from defective DNA repair, replication, and mitosis.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how accumulated mutations drive multi-step cancer development and how inherited mutations accelerate this evolutionary process.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and recommended reading.
